description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
